description: Keep nursery essentials within arm's reach with the Addison 3 Drawer Nightstand. Crafted from solid hardwood in a warm Brown Maple finish, this compact nightstand features three smooth-gliding drawers with dovetail construction for lasting durability. Use it beside the glider to hold burp cloths, pacifiers, and a book, or place it next to the crib for late-night diaper changes and feedings. The timeless design coordinates perfectly with the full Addison collection, making it a versatile addition to your nursery or, later, your child's bedroom. Baby-safe, non-toxic finish.
